title: VyOS Routing & Firewall: Zero to Hero
summary: Configure VyOS interfaces, static routes, OSPF, NAT, and site-to-site VPN for AI cluster edge networking.
sections: VyOS is a Debian-based network OS with a JunOS-like CLI. It runs on bare metal or VMs at the edge of GPU clusters, handling north-south traffic, BGP to ISPs, and east-west segmentation.
Boot VyOS, set host-name, configure eth0/eth1 with set interfaces ethernet. commit; save persists to /config/config.boot.

configure
set interfaces ethernet eth0 address dhcp
commit; save
Add default route and internal summaries. show ip route verifies FIB.

set protocols static route 0.0.0.0/0 next-hop 203.0.113.1
show ip route
Enable OSPF on internal VLANs so training nodes learn routes to storage and inference subnets.

set protocols ospf area 0 network 10.10.0.0/16
show ip ospf neighbor
Source NAT for GPU nodes without public IPs. set nat source rule and firewall name.

set nat source rule 100 outbound-interface eth0
set firewall name WAN default-action drop

title: PXE, iPXE & Network Boot: Zero to Hero
summary: DHCP options, TFTP, iPXE chains, and UEFI HTTP boot for bare-metal AI node provisioning.
sections: Preboot eXecution Environment loads a bootloader via DHCP+TFTP. Option 66 = next-server, option 67 = bootfile. UEFI uses ipxe.efi or grubx64.efi.
Configure dhcp-range, tftp-root, and pxelinux or iPXE. In FixitLab baremetal labs maas and pxe keywords trigger simulator output.
Chain from PXE ROM to iPXE script that HTTP-fetches kernel+initrd — required for large GPU driver initrds.
Modern servers boot directly over HTTP(S) without TFTP size limits. Match Secure Boot keys.
Common failures: wrong VLAN, blocked UDP 67/69, MTU on TFTP, or stale DHCP lease. tcpdump -i eth0 port 67 or 69.

title: NVIDIA & AMD GPU Troubleshooting for AI Engineers
summary: Driver mismatches, ECC errors, thermal throttle, persistence mode, and ROCm vs CUDA debugging.
sections: Start with nvidia-smi or rocm-smi. Xid errors in dmesg indicate GPU resets. Thermal throttle shows as SW power cap or GPU Max Operating Temp.
DKMS rebuild fails after kernel upgrade. Match driver branch to CUDA in containers. blacklist nouveau before NVIDIA install.
Training jobs peg power limits. Fix rack airflow, replace fans, use nvidia-smi -pl to cap until hardware fixed.
rocminfo lists agents. HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES mirrors CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES. Mixed vendor clusters need separate queues.
NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME and IB HCA selection matter for all-reduce. Test with nccl-tests before large jobs.
